note: Dewey County SD's own ArcGIS service (DEWEY_COUNTY_LAYERS, DEWEY_COUNTY_LAYERS2) publishes townships, sections, parcels, tribal, plat, school, precinct and ward layers but no zoning districts; the PARCELS layer has no zoning field. Landrecords reports zoning fields unpopulated. Searches for Eagle Butte and Timber Lake city zoning found no zoning ordinance, map or GIS layer; most of the county is Cheyenne River reservation land.
